Q: Preview of an AlertDialog doesn't work in Jetpack Compose A:

Change preview from

@Preview(showBackground = true)

To

@Preview(showBackground = true, showSystemUi = true)

Not sure why it works, but it does.

Ssometimes it shows a black ui (in that case, making change in a text component fixes it).

Q: Excel formula to extract file name from paths without file extension A:

=LEFT(TEXTAFTER(CELL("filename"),"["),LEN(TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(CELL("filename"), "["), "]")))

Q: Can a lambda function call itself recursively in Python? A:

Contrary to what sth said, you CAN directly do this.

(
    lambda f:
        (lambda x: f(lambda v: x(x)(v)))
        (lambda x: f(lambda v: x(x)(v)))
)(
    lambda f:
        lambda i: 1 if (i == 0) else i * f(i - 1)
)(n)

The first part is an applicative-order fixed-point combinator, commonly called the Z combinator:

Z = lambda f: (
    lambda x: f(lambda v: x(x)(v))
)(
    lambda x: f(lambda v: x(x)(v))
)

the second part I'll call fact and is like the factorial function except it is not itself recursive. It accepts a function f representing the recursive call and returns a new function.

fact = (lambda f: (lambda i: 1 if (i == 0) else i * f(i - 1)))

Z is applied to fact to form the factorial function

F = Z(fact)

which is applied to the third part, n, which evaluates to the nth factorial

>>> n = 5
>>> F(n)
120

or equivalently

>>> (lambda f: (lambda x: f(lambda v: x(x)(v)))(lambda x: f(lambda v: x(x)(v))))(lambda f: (lambda i: 1 if (i == 0) else i * f(i - 1)))(5)
120

If however you prefer fibs to facts you can do that too using the same combinator

>>> (lambda f: (lambda x: f(lambda v: x(x)(v)))(lambda x: f(lambda v: x(x)(v))))(lambda f: (lambda i: f(i - 1) + f(i - 2) if i > 1 else 1))(5)
8

Q: Vscode cannot connect to remote Linux （_WebSocket close with status code 1006） A:

What helped me was to reset the cache of VSCode Server.
(Deleting the whole folder works too, but then also all Extensions on the Remote Host are gone as well).

Discover relevant entries:

find ~/.vscode-server -type d  -iname "*cache*"

Delete cached files, like:

rm -rf ~/.vscode-server/data/CachedProfilesData
rm -rf ~/.vscode-server/data/CachedExtensionVSIXs

Restart the WSL, or the remote server.

Restart VSCode and reconnect.

Q: Looking for the right framework to implement an enterprise document management and analysis system A:

Check out Haystack which is being used by Airbus. It can easily be self-hosted and customized via a YAML file. It can fulfill the following requirements -

  • Enterprise-ready (on-premises or compatible with Microsoft Azure)
  • Low-code framework
  • Large-scale document management and analysis
  • Modular and extensible via Python and NLP models
  • Allowing for metadata and smart search within and across documents

Following requirement currently not possible -

  • Connectable to business logic (i.e. checks for completeness of document collections)
